kicker: Sterlite Technologies · Q2 FY27 results and call
title: Sterlite Tech's margin is nearing its FY29 target, two years early.
dek: Revenue rose 145% to ₹2,529 Cr and operational EBITDA margin reached 27.1%, so management lifted its FY29 target to about 30%, from 27%.

chart.title: EBITDA margin: reported vs management's targets
chart.sub: company-reported operational margin; targets from the Q1 and Q2 FY27 calls

stats.label: Open order book
stats.note: 4.6× the ₹7,687 Cr at the start of FY27; ₹18,618 Cr at end-Q1.

stats.label: Revenue growth
stats.note: ₹2,529 Cr in Q2 FY27. Reported EBITDA of ₹846 Cr includes a ₹161 Cr one-off US tariff refund.

stats.label: Share price since results
stats.note: From 23 Oct to 17 Nov, while the index rose 11%.

read: Orders, margins and guidance have all stepped up three calls in a row; the stock's fall after results says the market now wants proof the margins hold.
sources: Sterlite Technologies Q2 FY27 results (BSE, 23 Oct 2026) and Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 earnings calls; prices to 17 Nov 2026
notes: Margins are the company's operational EBITDA margins as stated on its calls; Q1 FY27 is derived from reported EBITDA (₹397 Cr) and revenue (₹1,910 Cr), and Q2 FY27 excludes the ₹161 Cr one-off tariff refund. Profit growth is flattered by that refund and a low base. The Q2 call flagged rising receivables and did not disclose utilisation. Not a recommendation.
